comment: Tutorial settings stop at k_tol=1e-6 (balance_residual_tolerance=1e-3). The gold is the tightly converged k, 1.17155112 (k_tol=1e-10, balance_residual_tolerance=1e-8). Stopping once |dk| < k_tol on a geometric tail with ratio rho leaves an error of about k_tol*rho/(1-rho): the observed rho of about 0.67 gives 2e-6, and abs_tol=3e-6 covers rho up to 0.75. The solve must converge with no skipped CMFD corrections.
